args.explanation: Shrunk scenario has high sensor_noise (0.0152) comparable to initial theta (0.017). Noisy angle measurement causes controller to apply large, misdirected forces, pumping energy into system (energy grows from ~1.45 to 16.5 at step 38 to 37.5 at step 43) and accelerating cart negative with growing pole angular rate. Pole angle grows from 0.22 rad at step 38 to 0.44 at step 40 to violate 0.8 limit at step 43. Removing noise alone stabilizes: same plant/initial conditions with sensor_noise=0 has no violation and near-constant energy.
